project_name.justification: The project is identified as 'Charlot-Neely' in the body of the text, as part of a portfolio: 'Fulcrum’s Charlot-Neely, Fontaine Lake, Snowbird and South Pendleton uranium projects'. The metadata header also confirms the name as 'Charlot-Neely Lake Project'.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as 'Global Energy Metals Corporation TSXV:GEMC | OTCQB:GBLEF | FSE:5GE1 (“Global Energy Metals”, the “Company” and/or “GEMC”)'.

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer is identified in the text: 'Mitchell Smith, CEO & Director comments:'.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Global Energy Metals was granted an option to acquire a percentage interest in the project portfolio: 'GEMC will also be granted an option to acquire a 19.9% interest in the Projects'.

primary_commodity.justification: The press release headline states: 'Global Energy Metals Invests In Uranium Sector; Enters Agreement To Acquire Royalty And Option On Saskatchewan-Based Uranium Portfolio'.

verified_article_link.justification: No article link was provided in the source documents.

currency.justification: The currency is specified in the share payment terms: '...five million shares at a deemed price of CAD $0.06 per share to Fulcrum.'

cash_payments_raw.justification: The consideration for the initial agreement was in shares, not cash, fitting Priority 2 of the financial extraction hierarchy.

share_payments_raw.justification: The consideration is described with the number of shares and a price per share, which corresponds to Priority 2 of the financial extraction hierarchy, populating `amount_of_shares_issued` and `issued_share_price` instead.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The consideration was not a single combined value; it was specified as a number of shares at a set price, fitting Priority 2 of the financial extraction hierarchy.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The project's share is 1,250,000 shares, calculated as one-fourth of the total 5,000,000 shares issued for the portfolio of four projects (Charlot-Neely, Fontaine Lake, Snowbird and South Pendleton). The total is stated as: 'GEMC will issue, subject to Exchange approval, five million shares at a deemed price of CAD $0.06 per share to Fulcrum.'

option_payments_raw.justification: No stock options were mentioned as part of the transaction consideration.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: No exploration commitment in terms of drilling meters was mentioned in the transaction details.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: No specific monetary exploration commitment for Global Energy Metals was outlined in the transaction terms. The text only notes that 'Future exploration requires the undertaking of a modern systematic geologic evaluation to determine the resource potential.'

coverage_area_unit.justification: The unit for the project area is given in the description: 'Charlot-Neely ... Totalling 16,372 hectares'.

resource_size.justification: The text indicates no formal mineral resource estimate exists, stating that 'Future exploration requires the undertaking of a modern systematic geologic evaluation to determine the resource potential' and mentioning a 'Post Resource' phase, implying no current resource has been defined.
